title: Dimension ratings (1 to 5) with histograms, separate from upvotes
description:
As a signed-in reader, I want to rate an item on each configured dimension from 1 to 5, so that the board reflects more than popularity.

Dimensions are publication data (for the Shipped pilot: real, useful, notable, novel). Per dimension store mean, n and the five-bucket histogram; n differs per dimension. Editors' ratings are stored with voterRole "editor" and tallied as their own mean. The upvote count and the number of people who rated are different numbers and are labelled as such.

```gherkin
Feature: Dimension ratings
  Scenario: Rate
    When a reader rates the dimension "A" with 4
    Then the tally for "A" has n increased by one and an updated mean and histogram

  Scenario: Change a rating
    When the same reader rates "A" again with 2
    Then the earlier rating is replaced

  Scenario: Editor mean separate
    When editors and readers have rated
    Then the reader mean and the editor mean are both available and distinct

  Scenario: Partial rating
    Given a reader rates only two of the four dimensions
    Then only those two tallies change
```
